2.desc: When the number of ally targets on the field is not equal to 4, for every 1 additional/missing ally target, increases the DMG dealt by the wearer and their memosprite by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, stacking up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>/<unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> time(s).
